statements.statement: The PLOS One editors retracted the article. The retraction notice's title names this paper's title.
Retracted because one of a series of submissions with concerns about peer review integrity and potential manipulation; concerns call into question validity and provenance.
The paper's headline result is that its RNN method performs better than recent approaches.
The retraction applies to the whole article, including performance results, so findings cannot be relied on.
The author either did not respond or could not be reached.
Section 3 names Dutta [14] as main evidence for LURL; LURL reached 97.4% and 96.8%, higher than both comparison detectors.
The draft chose an LSTM over other detectors and decided not to run a model-selection study.
Section 4 starts from LURL settings: two LSTM layers, hidden 650, lr 1.0 decay 0.73, no tuning before pilot.
The editors retracted the article and say concerns call into question validity and provenance.
Section 3 accuracy results are among those questioned; Section 4 settings come from the retracted article; impact is high.
The editors retracted the article and say concerns call into question validity and provenance.
Section 3 names Dutta [14] as main evidence, chose LSTM and skipped model selection; Section 4 starts from Dutta's settings and does not tune.
